items.title: Costco (COST) Beats Q4 Earnings and Revenue Estimates

items.title: 2 Mid-Cap Stocks with Exciting Potential and 1 We Avoid
items.summary: Mid-cap stocks often strike the right balance between having proven business models and market opportunities that can support $100 billion corporations. However, they face intense competition from scaled industry giants and can be disrupted by new innovative players vying for a slice of the pie.

items.title: Deckers Outdoor (DECK) Stock May Be 48% Undervalued As UGG Campaign Starts
items.summary: Deckers Outdoor has seen a sharp reset in sentiment, with the share price weaker over the past year. That shift puts a spotlight on whether the current valuation lines up with the cash the business is expected to generate. The stock has fallen 29.3% over the past year, which places extra weight on the question of what the underlying cash flows are really worth today. items.title: Why Did On Holding Stock Jump If Its Near-Term Guidance Did Not Change?
items.summary: On Holding (ONON) stock rose 7.6% on Tuesday, September 22, 2026, while the S&P 500 finished flat. At its investor day in Zurich, the company unveiled its first share buyback and targets for 2029. What the market bought was a promise to keep choosing price over volume.
